📺 Hilda WON. You didn't see it — you had your own arena. The village will tell you about it for weeks.
📺 Prize for Hilda: the winner's share — alien rations for the pantry. The village eats tonight.
📺 The System presses something humming into Hilda's hands: Investigator's Coat. Twenty-seven pockets, and you remember what's in all of them. That's the real trick.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Lily Simpson is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Lily is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
Stonebridge watches to see if Haven holds without its dead — and presses the tribute down to 3,000 kcal/week while the chair is empty. They'll test the link. Count on it. (Trust -8.)

🕯️ Lily's funeral feast: 1,500 kcal from the pantry, and every shaken fire is fed — Stonebridge. The village mourns together, and the links hold because the dead are honored, not because the grief was forgotten. (Trust mended — the -8 bought back with grain.)
🕯️ Lily Simpson is dead — the arena. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Lily kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
"Lily's gone." Hilda looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Lily." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Nora blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Lily Simpson, 78 days. The mantle passes to Nora Ma.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Nora Ma, 44 — an emergency dispatcher. Her hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Lucky Rock, Night Eyes, Trophy Room, Scream Cheese, Berserker Rage.
◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Stalker of the Apex Predator." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
The village's quarrel was with Lily — and Lily is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
At the grave, Hilda, Irving, Hayden and 5 more speak for Nora — "Lily trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Nora before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
